verdict.rationale: Salesforce offers a self-serve 30-day free trial and ships pipeline objects (leads, accounts, contacts, opportunities), so a founder can sign up and see a pipeline without a partner. Nothing in the evidence shows getting real data into it quickly, and one community comment says companies in practice pay for 'an army of salesforce consultants', while another notes customization is needed. missing for 10: data import/migration tooling, any time-to-value or setup-speed evidence, guided onboarding for a working pipeline, independent hands-on reports of partner-free setup within an hour.
